szoveg_eredeti:
Crime pays: Rockstar Games’ “Grand Theft Auto 6″ preorder and first-day sales reached $3.79 billion, the game developer announced Friday.

Per Rockstar Games parent company Take-Two Interactive, that total sets “a new record for entertainment across any medium” and makes “GTA 6” “the biggest entertainment launch in history.”

A spokesperson for Take-Two Interactive declined to comment on the number of “GTA 6” copies sold. For the sake of comparison, Sony Pictures’ “Spider-Man: Brand New Day” reaped $2.52 billion at the global box office in 2026, the No. 1 movie of the year to date. On its first day of release, “GTA 6” made roughly as much as James Cameron’s last two “Avatar” movies, “The Way of Water” and “Fire and Ash,” have grossed combined. With just Day 1 sales, “GTA 6” has already out-grossed the highest grossing movie of all time, “Avengers: Endgame” ($2.9 billion), in one day.

“GTA 6” launched Thursday for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X and S and was also available on Xbox One via Xbox’s Cloud Gaming service. The game retails at $80 for the standard edition and $100 for the ultimate version. Preorders for “GTA 6” opened June 25.

With a reported total gameplay time of approximately 80 hours to complete its main storyline, “GTA 6” follows duo Jason and Lucia as they navigate their way through criminal life in the fictional Leonida.
